subject: Renewal & expansion recap — Acme Corp (Q2 renewal)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & expansion recap — Acme Corp (Q2 renewal)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have alignment ahead of your March renewal: 

Key takeaways
- Primary drivers: ramping cost and inconsistent latency at peak for the chat/assistant flows; desire to reduce 90th/95th p99 latency spikes and stabilize unit cost.
- New workload: expanded semantic search/embeddings for product catalog (projected +3x embedding calls over the next 6 months).
- Current usage: roughly 15M tokens/month (generation) + 120k embedding calls in Q4; see attached usage_report_q4_acme.csv for detail.
- Proposal path: Pilot Dedicated capacity (1 node) to validate latency SLO and cost profile, then scale to reserved capacity for Q2 if results meet KPI.

Agreed timelines
- Feb: technical pilot (2-4 week pilot window) to validate latency/cost and run quality A/B tests.
- Mar 15: final decision date (contract renewal window).
- Apr: begin ramp if pilot successful.

Open items / next steps (owner)
1) I will send a pilot scope + MoP draft and a cost model by EOD tomorrow. (Marissa)
2) Michael to run a short technical deep-dive with your infra team to confirm integration points and KV cache setup (schedule proposed below). (Michael)
3) Acme to confirm pilot dataset and two evaluation prompt sets for quality regression checks. (Samantha / Tom)
4) Provide SOC2 evidence & compliance questionnaire answers (we can share our report and a compliance call). (Marissa)

Attachments: usage_report_q4_acme.csv, draft_scope_mop.docx

Proposed times for technical deep-dive: Wed, Jan 20 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu, Jan 21 9:00-10:00 PT — Michael will lead. Please confirm which works.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical for your product teams

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@acme.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion recap — Acme Corp (Q2 renewal)

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. Confirming a few items from our side:
- Timeline looks right. March 15 decision target is good.
- We definitely want the pilot to include a production-like traffic replay to capture the latency behavior at your end (90/95/99 latency percentiles).
- We will provide two evaluation prompt sets by end of week (catalog search + customer support triage).

A couple of asks:
1) Can Redwood provide a short compliance package (SOC2 PDF + a completed security questionnaire) for our procurement team? We need that to start the procurement timeline.
2) We'd prefer to run the pilot in the week starting Feb 7 — is that workable?
3) Tom from infra will join the technical deep-dive (he's cc'd).

One more: before we commit to Reserved capacity, we want a clear delta on unit cost vs current hosted and a playbook for fallback to hosted if there are unexpected regressions. Can you confirm you can provide a ROI/cost delta sheet?

On the timing: if pilot begins the week of Feb 7 and runs 2-4 weeks, that gives us enough time to evaluate before the March 15 decision.

Thanks — Samantha

Samantha Lee
Director, AI Platforms | Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 17:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion recap — Acme Corp (Q2 renewal)

Samantha —

Great — appreciate the quick confirmation. A few updates based on your asks: 
- Compliance: attaching our SOC2 summary + draft_scope_mop.docx (see attachment). We'll also fill out the standard procurement questionnaire and put it in the shared drive link below.
- Pilot timing: Week of Feb 8 (Mon 2027-02-08) works well for us. Suggested pilot window: 2 weeks with an optional 2-week extension if you want more traffic coverage. Pilot scope attached (pilot_scope_acme.pdf).
- ROI / cost delta: I'll send a concise cost delta sheet and an expected unit-cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated pilot) by tomorrow morning. That will include assumptions and projected monthly costs at 1x/2x/3x usage.

Michael — can you run the technical deep-dive on Wed, Jan 20 at 10:00 PT? If that's tight I can move to Thu Jan 21 9:00 PT per Samantha's earlier note.

Quoted for context:

Marissa / Samantha —

Thanks — Tom here (infra). Confirming I'll join the technical deep-dive. Wed Jan 20 10:00 PT works for our team. A couple asks from infra:
- Please include expected network egress and TLS mutual auth details in the pilot plan.
- We will need an internal PO timeline estimate for procurement — can you share a ballpark lead time for Reserved capacity contracts and any associated billing milestones?

Samantha and I will review the pilot_scope_acme.pdf and the usage_report later today and get back with the eval prompt sets by Friday.
